symptom: my 16x2 I2C LCD backpack never initializes. The example hardcodes 0x3f and I get an I2C error.

files.lcd.py:
import board, busio
from lcd_i2c import LCD
i2c = busio.I2C(board.SCL, board.SDA)
lcd = LCD(i2c, address=0x3f)
lcd.write('hello')

gold.diagnosis: i2cdetect shows the PCF8574 LCD backpack at 0x27 (39), not 0x3f (63). The 0x3f/0x27 split is the classic PCF8574 vs PCF8574A variant difference; many examples hardcode 0x3f. This backpack uses 0x27. Change the address.
